title: House
description: A noble house from the A Song of Ice and Fire universe.

url.description: The canonical URL of this house resource.

name.description: The full name of the house.

region.description: The geographic region this house is based in.

coatOfArms.description: Heraldic description of the house's coat of arms.

words.description: The house words (motto). Empty if unknown.
examples: A Lannister Always Pays His Debts

currentLord.description: URL of the current lord character resource, or empty string if unknown.

heir.description: URL of the current heir character resource, or empty string if unknown.

overlord.description: URL of the overlord house resource, or empty string if none.

founded.description: Text description of when the house was founded.

founder.description: URL of the founding character resource, or empty string if unknown.

diedOut.description: Text description of when the house died out. Empty if still active.

ancestralWeapons.description: Names of ancestral weapons belonging to this house.

swornMembers.description: URLs of characters sworn to this house.
